## Standing operator rules
- Split work into separate branches whenever a change set contains more than one Jira ticket, even if the tickets share a release train.
- Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Run “Monthly payroll run 2025-03” in between other work, following all eight listed steps in order, one at a time.
- Never edit `grafana/ledgerly-billing-v3.json` without first posting the proposed dashboard change in `#obs-dashboard` for `@mina` to review.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.

## Current objective
Fix the nightly reconciliation job in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`, which is double-counting refunds. The Tenacity refactor was superseded and stopped until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Sandbox payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and must not be used.
- Request context: `current_request_id`; formatter now includes `request_id`.
- Tenacity: `ledgerly/sync/client.py`.
- Reconciliation: `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.
- Scheduler: `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py`.
- Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, batch `batch-20250328-1842`, requests `run-20250328-payroll` and `notify-20250328-payroll`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Tenacity retry-loop refactor: postponed until next sprint.
- Disabling idempotency middleware: caused duplicate staging invoices.
- Positive-only invoice filtering: discarded credit lines.
- Per-page invoice-header reservation: caused inconsistent totals wrapping.
- Legacy declarative base and `Query.get()`: deprecated.

## Plan and progress
- Reconciliation refund fix: pending; no diagnosis or implementation recorded.
- Scheduler DST failure: investigation pending. `pytest tests/test_scheduler.py -q` produced 7 passed, 1 failed because 09:00 became 10:00 across the March DST transition.
- Structured logging work: complete; `python -m ledgerly.logging --show-config` exited 0, and `pytest -q` produced 142 passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed. Health expectations were then fixed; `pytest -q tests/api/test_health.py` produced 4 passed.
- Invoice and payment logging tests produced 11 passed and 18 passed, 1 skipped respectively.
- Payroll steps 1–5 are done; steps 6–8 remain pending, but their exact commands were not retained and must not be guessed.
- Next pending command: `sed -n '1,240p' src/ledgerly/scheduler/timezone.py`.

- Positive-only amount filtering: discarded credit lines; use negative-aware rendering.
- Duplicate local decimal formatting in `_format_lines()`: omitted locale grouping; use `format_money()`.

- Payroll steps 2–8: pending.
